title: Your first note: B
goal: make a steady sound on B and hold it for four full beats.

title: Tonguing
goal: start every note with your tongue, not with a push of air, so repeated notes are clearly separated.

title: New note: A
goal: switch between B and A cleanly, moving just one finger.

title: New note: G
goal: have three notes — B, A, G — and play your first real tune.

title: Long tones
goal: long, even breath — the foundation of a beautiful sound.

title: New note: C
goal: move from B to C — the trickiest finger change of week one.

title: Week 1 review
goal: review G A B C and all three songs, played straight through.

title: High D and the octave key
goal: meet the octave key and your first high note.

title: Thirds
goal: skip a note and still sound smooth.

title: E and low D
goal: low notes with a round sound — no honking.
notes: New Notes: E and Low D

title: High E and eighth notes
goal: add high E and read eighth notes.
notes: New Note: High E + Eighth Notes

title: F# and the G major scale
goal: understand the sharp at the start of the staff and play the G major scale.

title: Loud and soft, and fifths
goal: control your volume without changing the pitch.

title: Week 2 review
goal: review every note from low D to high E.

title: Pickups and ties
goal: come in at the right moment when a song doesn't start on beat 1.
song: When the Saints Go Marching In

title: Repeated notes
goal: fast, light tonguing on repeated notes.

title: Three-four time
goal: feel three beats in a bar.

title: Slurs
goal: join notes of different pitches into one smooth line.

title: F and low C
goal: reach the lowest note of the course.
notes: New Notes: F and Low C

title: High F and high G
goal: reach the highest notes of the course.
notes: New Notes: High F and G

title: Week 3 review
goal: review both scales and every note from low C to high G.
notes: Review: G and C Major Scales

title: Dotted quarter notes
goal: read dotted rhythms accurately.

title: Breath control
goal: stretch your breath to play whole phrases.

title: Swing
goal: feel the swing rhythm of jazz.

title: G# and minor keys
goal: discover the sound of a minor key.

title: Staccato and legato
goal: play the same notes in two very different styles.

title: Octave leaps
goal: jump between low and high notes without cracking.

title: Playing by ear
goal: hear a melody and find it on your sax.
notes: Review: All Notes (Low C to High G)

title: Recital rehearsal
goal: put songs together into a short performance.

title: Your recital
goal: finish the course with a complete performance.
